title: Gloo Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Gloo Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Q4 and full-year FY2026 financial results (press release dated April 14, 2026) and disclosing an asset purchase agreement dated April 12, 2026 to acquire substantially all assets of Enterprisemarketdesk (WDMarketdesk, LLC) in a stock-for-assets transaction expected to close in Q2 FY2026.
key_points: Gloo Holdings issued a press release (Exhibit 99.1) on April 14, 2026 reporting Q4 and full-year FY2026 financial results.

Gloo, LLC (wholly-owned subsidiary) entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with WDMarketdesk, LLC on April 12, 2026 to acquire substantially all assets and certain liabilities of Enterprisemarketdesk.
At closing, the company will issue approximately 1,464,286 shares of Class A common stock based on an assumed VWAP of $7.00.
The transaction is expected to close in Q2 FY2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
The company qualifies as an emerging growth company under SEC rules.
Shares are being issued under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506 exemptions from Securities Act registration.
